name: Antimatter15 .splat File Parsing
definition: A lazy ChunkSource implementation for reading Antimatter15 .splat files, which are flat arrays of 32-byte records with no header. It decodes position, geometric (rotation, scale, opacity), and DC-only color layers on demand, supporting both contiguous chunk reads and scatter-gather reads.
summary: Antimatter15 .splat File Parsing implements a lazy ChunkSource for 32-byte binary records, decoding Gaussian properties on demand without spherical harmonic data.
